joinTypes.innerHelp: Inner join · Only the {{field}} values in both {{thisQuery}} and {{otherQuery}}. Everything unmatched is dropped.
joinTypes.leftHelp: Left join · Only the {{field}} values in {{thisQuery}}. Anything found solely in {{otherQuery}} is dropped.
joinTypes.fullOuterHelp: Full outer join · Every {{field}} from either query. Where one side has no match, its columns are blank.

joinBar.matchSummary: match <bold>{{thisQuery}}</bold> and <bold>{{otherQuery}}</bold> on a shared field
joinBar.emptySource: {{emptyLabel}}'s columns are blank on every row: its query returned no rows matching {{otherLabel}} on {{field}}.
joinBar.fanOut_one: {{split}} is split by {{fields}}, which {{other}} does not have. Merging would repeat {{other}}'s rows once per value. Remove it, select it on both queries and join on it
joinBar.fanOut_other: {{split}} is split by {{fields}}, which {{other}} does not have. Merging would repeat {{other}}'s rows once per value. Remove them, select them on both queries and join on them
joinBar.repeating: {{repeating}}'s values repeat on every {{other}} row with the same {{field}}. Its columns have no totals here.
